caption: The video captures a beach bonfire burning at dusk, with two dark driftwood branches angled upward and outward from the glowing sand pit. Behind the fire, a calm sea meets a low horizon beneath broad orange and blue-gray clouds. The camera remains fixed, so the logs, waterline, and cloud pattern hold steady while only the flames visibly move. The main flame body continually flickers, stretching into bright tongues, dimming, and curling around the burning wood. Pale detached wisps rise above the logs, drifting slowly upward and sideways as embers lift from the fire. At times two separate flame blobs float near the tips of the branches, then shift, thin, and re-form into a single rising puff. The rounded puff elongates, bends, and breaks apart, while brighter yellow flame continues to lick the lower wood. A red glow spreads across the sand around the pit, staying nearly constant as the sunset light dominates the sky. The scene shows an ongoing fire process, with flames and embers evolving against the still sea and clouded horizon.
